title: docs/test.md: an interrupt before the run directory can still leave an empty review-runs parent
outcome: docs/test.md's deliberately-unchanged entry for a launch interrupted before request.json says precisely what may remain on disk: on a checkout without the review-runs parent, a stop during the recursive directory creation can leave that empty parent, which no later launch reads; and its examples of pre-directory stopping points read as examples, not a complete list.
acceptance: docs/test.md: an interrupt before the run directory can still leave an empty review-runs parent is done
